I updated `src/billing/tax.py` so tax rounds half-up. `tax_for` was only a `NotImplementedError` stub, so I wrote it out in full:

```python
def tax_for(amount_cents, rate):
    tax = Decimal(amount_cents) * Decimal(str(rate))
    return int(tax.quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
```

It takes an amount in integer cents and returns whole cents, rounding .5 up. I ran a quick check: 250¢ at 5% gives 13¢ (half-even would give 12), and 350¢ at 5% gives 18¢. The repo doesn't have tests for this function, so I didn't run a test suite.
